## Description

A clear description of the feature you'd like to add.

## Motivation

Why do you need this feature? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

How should this feature work? What would the API or interaction look like?

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you've thought about?

## Module Affected

- [ ] TokenRegistry (design system)
- [ ] GateRegistry (quality gates)
- [ ] DesktopEnvironment (boot sequence)
- [ ] TestOrchestrator (test framework)
- [ ] CLI tools
- [ ] Multiple modules (describe)

## Additional Context

Any diagrams, examples, or other context?
